mapper.select: SELECT distinct category_id, practice_set_id FROM oj_practice_theory

select oj_practice_theory.resource_id, oj_practice_theory.title, oj_practice_theory.content, oj_practice_theory.category_id, oj_practice_category.name as category_name, oj_practice_theory.theory_type as question_type, oj_practice_theory.`option`, oj_practice_theory.score, oj_practice_theory.answer from oj_practice_theory left join oj_practice_category on oj_practice_theory.category_id = oj_practice_category.resource_id where oj_practice_theory.resource_id in
#{theoryId}
